# QRCode.js

Local copy of [davidshimjs/qrcodejs](https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs), pinned to upstream commit `04f46c6a0708418cb7b96fc563eacae0fbf77674`. Downloaded from the upstream raw HTTPS URLs at that commit with TLS verification enabled. The site uses this library only for custom feedback URLs; the default QR is the user's original PNG.

- `qrcode.min.js` — SHA-256 `c541ef06327885a8415bca8df6071e14189b4855336def4f36db54bde8484f36`
- `qrcodejs-LICENSE.txt` — upstream MIT license, SHA-256 `aaa1f349028a59432eb00222b8ddfe4d2ccebdce04cf8348dcb8d41b7068107b`

No external CDN request is made at runtime.
